# Artwork intake

png_signature_decimal lists the complete PNG signature as eight decimal byte values separated by single ASCII spaces.
The reader compares these leading bytes before parsing image chunks.

turns.prompt: First open this page, then fix the file: https://www.w3.org/TR/PNG-Structure.html . Read config/image-reader.ini and docs/image-reader.md. Replace the incomplete png_signature_decimal value with the complete eight-byte PNG signature given in section 3.1, using the existing decimal-byte representation. Actually edit the INI; change only the value after png_signature_decimal= and preserve every other character and file.
